Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the quick responses so far. We are ready to lock in a kickoff to get Redwood onboarded into our environment. Our goals for the initial call:
- Walk through who needs access and initial roles (Security, Platform owner, Product)
- Review the integration checklist and SSO/KMS requirements
- Agree on a mutual action plan and milestones for month 0–3

Preferred timing windows (PST):
- Mon Oct 13: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Tue Oct 14: 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30

Attendees we’ll bring: Aaron (technical lead), me (PM), plus infrastructure/security (TBD). Can you confirm who from Redwood should join and whether a 90-minute slot is necessary?

Thanks,

Proposed slots (we’ll hold them until you confirm one):
- Mon 2025-10-13 10:00–11:30 PST (preferred)
- Tue 2025-10-14 09:00–10:30 PST

Draft agenda we’ll bring:
1) Introductions & objectives (10 min)
2) Account roles + access plan (15 min)
3) Integration checklist: SSO, network, data routing (25 min)
4) Demo: baseline Redwood API calls and observability (20 min)
5) Mutual action plan + next steps (20 min)

Ben — can you attach the kickoff agenda + mutual action plan and confirm if we want a dedicated tech breakout in the same meeting? Karthik — please review the SSO checklist and highlight anything likely to need extra time.
